nbe6c9f7d4d.headline: India's crude basket sees sharp shift in November as Brent share falls to 53.49%, Oman Dubai gains - BusinessToday
nbe6c9f7d4d.summary: According to PPAC data released November 17, Brent Dated's share in India's crude basket fell 11.78 percentage points in November to 53.49%. Oman and Dubai gained by an equal margin.
nbe6c9f7d4d.why: India is one of the world's largest crude oil importers, so the mix of grades it buys shapes global crude demand and regional pricing. Shifts between Brent and Middle East benchmarks affect refiners' costs.

n8b7c69e309.headline: AirAsia, Malaysia Airports in RM500mil debt repayment talks
n8b7c69e309.summary: Malaysia Airports Holdings is in talks with AirAsia Group about a repayment plan for RM500 million owed by the low-cost airline, according to the airport operator.
n8b7c69e309.why: AirAsia is a major Southeast Asian low-cost carrier, and Malaysia Airports operates the country's main airports. Debt arrangements between them affect both companies' balance sheets.

n90861fe593.headline: Azerbaijani oil trades at $98 per barrel
n90861fe593.summary: The price of Azerbaijani Azeri Light crude oil on a CIF basis has declined on global markets to $98 per barrel, according to APA-Economics.
n90861fe593.why: Azeri Light is a benchmark grade from Azerbaijan's oil exports, and its price reflects global crude demand and supply. Oil prices affect energy costs and the revenues of exporting countries.

nb79e5d656b.headline: Italian agri-food costs more than GDP: Italy is first in Europe for added value
nb79e5d656b.summary: The Ismea Report on Italian agri-food 2026 cites almost 89 billion euros in value added, about 1.5 million employed and 72.5 billion euros in exports.
nb79e5d656b.why: The agri-food sector is a major part of Italy's economy and exports, and Ismea is the state agency that publishes sector statistics. The figures inform policy and agricultural investment decisions.

nf4bcf102d3.headline: UK to back Caspian-Europe clean energy transmission project – ambassador
nf4bcf102d3.summary: The United Kingdom will support an initiative to transmit clean energy from the Caspian region to the European market, under cooperation between Xlinks and the Green Energy Company, the ambassador said.
nf4bcf102d3.why: Xlinks is a UK company developing long-distance power transmission projects, and such interconnectors can change how renewable power reaches European grids. Government backing can affect financing and project timelines.

n2d9e0ed57b.headline: CGT changes under fire – what would Spender plan mean for property?
n2d9e0ed57b.summary: The Greens are warming to a teal alternative that keeps investment property on inflation indexation but gives shares and businesses a flat 40% discount, the Australian Broker reports.
n2d9e0ed57b.why: Capital gains tax rules shape returns on property and share investments in Australia. Changes to indexation and discounts directly affect investor after-tax returns.

n9da1e6584f.headline: Kyiv bridges struck as Russian attack disrupts essential services, mayor says
n9da1e6584f.summary: Kyiv bridges were struck in a Russian attack that disrupted essential services, according to the city's mayor.
n9da1e6584f.why: Attacks on transport infrastructure affect logistics, reconstruction costs and investor risk assessments for Ukraine. Damage to utilities and transport links weighs on the wider economy.

n6799661c0e.headline: East Africa: Comesa, EAC and SADC Empower Border Officials and Traders to Support Simplified Cross-Border Trade At Busia
n6799661c0e.summary: COMESA, the EAC and SADC began a two-day workshop on 16 November 2026 on the Tripartite Simplified Trade Regime at the Busia one-stop border post between Kenya and Uganda.
n6799661c0e.why: Regional trade blocs such as COMESA, the EAC and SADC work to reduce customs barriers across Africa. Simpler border procedures lower trade costs for traders moving goods between countries.

n50077725d1.headline: Greek Tax Burden Outpaced Income Growth by 10 Points Due to Fiscal Drag
n50077725d1.summary: New data shows household earnings growth lagged the rise in tax burden in Greece, widening the gap between incomes and purchasing power. The article attributes this to shifting fiscal policy.
n50077725d1.why: Fiscal drag occurs when inflation and wage growth push households into higher tax brackets, reducing disposable income and consumer spending. Greece's fiscal position matters to euro-area bond and equity investors.

nbf1d912607.headline: Unioleo inks underwriting agreement for ACE Market IPO
nbf1d912607.summary: Unioleo Holdings Bhd has signed an underwriting agreement with Berjaya Securities for its proposed initial public offering and upcoming ACE Market listing on Bursa Malaysia.
nbf1d912607.why: ACE Market is Bursa Malaysia's board for smaller and growing companies, and underwriting agreements are standard steps before an IPO prices.

n4f11c9720d.headline: Africa Cannot Keep Spending $100bn On Food Imports - Ruto
n4f11c9720d.summary: Kenyan President William Ruto called for reforms to the international financial system so Africa can secure long-term financing for agriculture. He cited an annual food import bill above $100 billion.
n4f11c9720d.why: Africa's food import bill affects trade balances, currency pressure and demand for imported grain and fertiliser, which matter to commodity and emerging-market investors.

n656e02ef2b.headline: Australian Market Extends Early Losses In Mid-market
n656e02ef2b.summary: The Australian stock market extended its early losses in mid-market trading on Tuesday, adding to losses from the previous three sessions. The move followed broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight.
n656e02ef2b.why: The S&P/ASX 200 is Australia's benchmark index, tracking the country's largest listed companies across banking, mining and healthcare.
n656e02ef2b.why_moved: The index extended its losses after broadly negative overnight cues from Wall Street, following three prior sessions of decline.

n359dc881b1.headline: Factories in Orenburg Region Find Solid Ground: Federal Center Hands the Region the Keys to Future Development
n359dc881b1.summary: A preferential loan of 1.9 billion rubles will fund infrastructure development in the Orenburzhye special economic zone. The financing covers 27 residents of the zone.
n359dc881b1.why: Special economic zones offer tax and financing incentives to manufacturers, shaping regional industrial investment. Investors track such regional support as an indicator of industrial capacity growth.

n0879f93f0d.headline: investingLive Asia-Pacific market news: RBA minutes lean hawkish
n0879f93f0d.summary: Minutes of the Reserve Bank of Australia's meeting showed most members judged the 4.85% rate was not clearly sufficient to bring inflation back to target. Governor Bullock flagged further considerations.
n0879f93f0d.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the country's cash rate, which drives borrowing costs and the Australian dollar. A hawkish tone signals that rates may stay high for longer.

ne65b3c9276.headline: Why is HAL under fire? Defence supply chain gaps flagged as Tejas Mark 1A aircraft deliveries to IAF face major delays | Today News
ne65b3c9276.summary: Tejas Mark 1A aircraft deliveries to the Indian Air Force face major delays, with defence supply chain gaps flagged. The aircraft is meant to replace ageing MiG-21 squadrons.
ne65b3c9276.why: Hindustan Aeronautics is India's state-owned aircraft maker and a key supplier to the Indian Air Force. Delivery delays can affect its revenue timing and order execution.

nf7d6502af0.headline: Rupee gains 31 paise against US dollar amid falling crude oil prices
nf7d6502af0.summary: The Indian rupee traded 31 paise higher against the US dollar in early deals on Tuesday. The move followed a fall in crude oil prices and strong foreign fund inflows.
nf7d6502af0.why: The rupee's value affects import costs, particularly for oil, which India imports in large quantities. Foreign portfolio flows are a key driver of the currency and local equity markets.

nef5cec9973.headline: Qantas has unveiled a major loyalty shake-up - here's how you can benefit
nef5cec9973.summary: Qantas has announced a major shake-up of its loyalty program. The change could make the Silver tier easier to reach without flying more.
nef5cec9973.why: Qantas is Australia's largest airline and its loyalty scheme drives customer retention and high-margin partner revenue. Changes to the program can affect future earnings.

nf347c7899d.headline: Trump is to arrive in the Philippines to talk trade and seek respite from troubles at home
nf347c7899d.summary: US President Donald Trump is expected to focus on economic talks and meet regional partners during his Philippines visit. He will also attend a banquet with Southeast Asian leaders.
nf347c7899d.why: Trade talks between the US and Asian partners shape tariff policy and supply-chain decisions that affect exporters and multinational companies.

n360a3fce48.headline: Azeri Light price declines to $98.76 per barrel at Augusta port
n360a3fce48.summary: The price of Azeri Light crude, Azerbaijan's benchmark grade, declined to $98.76 per barrel at the Augusta port. The report was dated November 17.
n360a3fce48.why: Azeri Light is a key export grade from the Caspian region, and its price reflects the broader oil market used by European refiners.

n08e4601e9c.headline: Australia’s TechnologyOne resists wave of AI job cuts to boost productivity
n08e4601e9c.summary: Australian enterprise software maker TechnologyOne said it is spurring research and development staff to double output. The aim is to resist the industry's wave of AI-driven job cuts.
n08e4601e9c.why: TechnologyOne is an Australian enterprise software company, and its approach to AI adoption indicates how software firms are managing productivity and workforce changes.

ndb99954ade.headline: Kuroda, once Japan’s great easer, says BOJ rates may need to rise above neutral
ndb99954ade.summary: Former Bank of Japan chief Haruhiko Kuroda said rates may need to rise above neutral if inflation worsens. He cited cost pressures from the Iran war and criticised a food tax cut.
ndb99954ade.why: The Bank of Japan sets Japan's short-term policy rate, which anchors yields on Japanese government bonds and the yen's value.

n9adc4de864.headline: Westinghouse Representative: Konin and the Region Have Advantages as a Location…
n9adc4de864.summary: Westinghouse representatives said Konin and the surrounding region have advantages as a nuclear power plant site. These must still be confirmed in technical analyses.
n9adc4de864.why: Westinghouse is a nuclear reactor technology company, and site selection is an early step in planning large-scale nuclear power projects.

n7211bfb3d0.summary: Abu Dhabi is making speed of doing business one of its strategic economic priorities. The emirate is targeting a 53% reduction in the time needed to start business operations.
n7211bfb3d0.why: Faster business licensing is part of efforts to attract foreign investment and diversify the Abu Dhabi economy away from oil.

nf3c9facabe.headline: Mugur Isărescu: Disinflation Is Taking Shape, but the Return to Balance Will Be Gradual
nf3c9facabe.summary: BNR Governor Mugur Isărescu said disinflation is taking shape in the Inflation Report of 16 November. He warned that inflationary pressures from fiscal and energy shocks have not disappeared.
nf3c9facabe.why: The National Bank of Romania sets monetary policy for the leu, and its inflation outlook guides interest rate expectations for Romanian bonds and currency.

n868e318fb5.summary: Greece's public finances are running almost 16 billion euros above initial fiscal targets. Households continue to feel the cost of high prices, rents and taxation.

n85146460eb.headline: Australian shares lose ground as miners tumble
n85146460eb.summary: Ten of the 11 local sectors on the ASX closed lower as jitters over the artificial intelligence narrative weighed on market confidence. Mining stocks were hit hard.

n85146460eb.why_moved: Concern about the artificial intelligence narrative reduced market confidence, and mining stocks were hit hardest.

nab55201b46.headline: Iraq-Germany Economic Cooperation Talks in Baghdad | Iraq Business News
nab55201b46.summary: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi received Germany's development minister Reem Alabali-Radovan in Baghdad. The sides discussed expanding economic, investment and trade cooperation, including a possible development memorandum of understanding.
nab55201b46.why: Government-level memoranda on investment and trade can open opportunities for German companies in Iraq's reconstruction and energy-related sectors.

n0ce33579ca.headline: Backpacker backtrack welcomed but regions want more
n0ce33579ca.summary: An increase in the number of backpackers allowed to stay in Australia for a third year has been welcomed, while regional areas want more. Details beyond this are not available in the input.
n0ce33579ca.why: Working-holiday visa programmes supply seasonal labour to agriculture and tourism, which feeds regional economies.

n366ba62434.headline: Kaynes Technology shares extend losses, fall another 4%; should investors worry about its Q2 performance? | Stock Market News
n366ba62434.summary: Kaynes Technology shares fell for a second session, down 4%, after weak September-quarter results. Adjusted profit dropped 62% year on year, margins fell and debt rose, and brokerages cut estimates.
n366ba62434.why: Kaynes Technology is an Indian electronics manufacturing services company serving industrial and consumer clients.

n00e10b8d46.summary: The government plans to allocate HUF 89 billion to tourism in the 2027 budget draft. A new support system will reward real results rather than connections, Minister István Kapitány announced.

nb8fbba5ac8.summary: Papua New Guinea continues to lose millions in export revenue and tax income from logging, according to research by ACT NOW PNG!. The report cites a K3 billion discrepancy in log export data.
nb8fbba5ac8.why: Log exports are a major revenue source for Papua New Guinea, and discrepancies affect state tax income.

n63dfc05fba.headline: SEBI mulls limits on margin trading as retail leverage hits Rs 1.53 lakh crore, says report - BusinessToday
n63dfc05fba.summary: India's SEBI is considering limits on margin-funded stock purchases as margin trading facility exposure rises to Rs 1.53 lakh crore. Proposed free-float thresholds could affect investors and brokers.
n63dfc05fba.why: SEBI is India's securities regulator, and rules on leveraged trading affect retail flows and brokerage businesses.

n07996fab04.summary: The Greek economy is producing large primary surpluses, exceeding initial fiscal targets by nearly 16 billion euros. The report does not detail the components of the surplus.
n07996fab04.why: A primary budget surplus excludes interest payments and signals fiscal strength to bond investors and rating agencies.

nafd04061ec.headline: India’s Music Economy Hits $1.8 Billion as Independent Music Claims 43% of Streams, EY Report Finds
nafd04061ec.summary: India's music economy generated $1.8 billion in 2025, up 45% from 2023. Independent artists took 43% of streams, according to an EY report.
nafd04061ec.why: The recorded and live music market is a growing part of the digital media economy, with streaming platforms as key revenue channels.

naab2fd18ad.headline: RBA boss Michele Bullock delivers tough message to mortgage holders
naab2fd18ad.summary: Reserve Bank of Australia Governor Michele Bullock has issued a new warning to mortgage holders. Business leaders are also sounding the alarm on the economy.
naab2fd18ad.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the country's cash rate, which drives variable mortgage rates and household borrowing costs. Its messaging shapes expectations for interest rates, the Australian dollar and bank stocks.

n4f1dc6a9b2.headline: Taiwan may take a backseat when Xi and Trump meet for a third time at an APEC summit
n4f1dc6a9b2.summary: Presidents Xi Jinping and Donald Trump are expected to meet this week at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum. Reports suggest Taiwan may take a backseat in talks.
n4f1dc6a9b2.why: US-China relations shape global trade, tariffs and supply chains, which affect multinational earnings and currency and equity markets across Asia.

n408e24576b.headline: PPC: EBITDA profits of €1.8 billion, investments of €2.6 billion and expansion into new European markets
n408e24576b.summary: Greek utility PPC reported EBITDA of €1.8 billion and investments of €2.6 billion. Renewable energy output rose 63% to 8.3 TWh, and the company is expanding into new European markets.
n408e24576b.why: Public Power Corporation is Greece's largest electricity producer and a major player in renewables, so its results indicate the health of the Greek and southeast European power sector.

nce84f7d3a1.summary: Investors continue to back leading Italian banks despite higher special taxes. Earnings are supported by growth in fee and commission income, sector consolidation and a rising interest rate environment.

n086224d187.summary: Climate campaigners have criticised the first draft of the COP31 cover decision for failing to advance commitments to move away from fossil fuels. The draft also omits promotion of renewable-based electrification.
n086224d187.why: Climate negotiations at the UN COP summits shape long-run policy on fossil fuels and renewables, which affects energy investment and demand for oil and gas.

n0c40fe53ae.summary: The IMF expects Ukraine's GDP to fall by 0.5% this year and by up to 1% next year. The forecast cites the war, attacks on infrastructure and prolonged combat operations.

n598f056740.summary: A gas shortage is deepening in Iran ahead of winter, with about 400 million cubic meters expected to be short. Supply shortages are feared in 11 of 31 provinces, and the government fears renewed unrest.

nd6ca60bdbf.summary: Minutes of the Reserve Bank of Australia meeting show a 6-3 vote to raise the cash rate to 4.85%. The majority prioritised inflation risks, while three dissenters warned of a sharper economic downturn.
nd6ca60bdbf.why: The RBA cash rate is the benchmark for Australian borrowing costs, and its decisions influence the Australian dollar, bond yields and domestic equities.

na78c77a5ff.headline: PSX: Stocks close lower as KSE-100 index dips over 665 points
na78c77a5ff.summary: The Pakistan Stock Exchange reported stocks closed lower as the KSE-100 index dropped more than 665 points. The index had closed at 178,182.95 points in the previous session.
na78c77a5ff.why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index of the Pakistan Stock Exchange in Karachi, tracking the country's largest listed companies.

n0494e37b73.headline: Trump arrives in Philippines to kick off Asia trip with economic deals and talks with allies
n0494e37b73.summary: President Trump arrived in the Philippines on Tuesday, where he was scheduled to meet regional partners and discuss trade. The visit opens an Asia tour that includes economic deals.
n0494e37b73.why: Presidential trade diplomacy shapes tariffs, supply chains and bilateral agreements that affect companies and currencies across Asia.

n8ecf278370.headline: Kenya: Equity Group Profit After Tax Jumps 32pc to Sh71.5bn On Higher Income
n8ecf278370.summary: Equity Group Holdings' profit after tax rose 32% to Sh71.5 billion in the nine months to September 2026. Growth came from higher interest and non-interest income and stronger regional operations.
n8ecf278370.why: Equity Group is one of East Africa's largest banking groups, listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange with operations across the region.

n89fd9fa3be.headline: Swarmer completes acquisition of Ukrainian drone maker Vataga Drone’s intellectual property
n89fd9fa3be.summary: Nasdaq-listed Swarmer has completed its acquisition of the intellectual property of Ukrainian drone maker Vataga Drone. Vataga specialises in strike FPV drones.
n89fd9fa3be.why: Swarmer is a defence technology company listed on Nasdaq since March 2026, and defence-tech deals are closely followed by investors in the sector.

nd7b812f101.headline: Stournaras: Greece is recovering, but incomes have yet to return to pre-crisis levels
nd7b812f101.summary: Bank of Greece governor Stournaras said Greece is recovering but incomes have yet to return to pre-crisis levels. The comments were reported by sofokleous10.gr.
nd7b812f101.why: The Bank of Greece is the country's central bank and a member of the euro system, and its assessments inform views on Greek growth and rates.

n8509954c85.headline: CPF Value Fund posts 50% increase in operating funds
n8509954c85.summary: CPF Value Fund reported a 50% rise in funds from operations attributable to shareholders, reaching Bd$5.95 million for the year ended September 30, 2026. Net asset value per share rose 9% to Bd$1.11.
n8509954c85.why: Real estate investment funds are valued on operating income, occupancy and net asset value, which are the metrics reported here.

nbe18cddfe2.headline: Batumi Oil Terminal’s throughput up 2.5% in January-October
nbe18cddfe2.summary: Batumi Oil Terminal, a Georgian asset of Kazakhstan's group, reported a 2.5% rise in throughput for January to October. The report was carried by Trend.Az.
nbe18cddfe2.why: Oil terminals handle crude and product flows for export routes linking Central Asia and the Caspian region with Black Sea ports.

nd50105f766.headline: Kenya, Singapore Sign Carbon Trading Deal to Unlock Climate Investment
nd50105f766.summary: Kenya and Singapore have signed a carbon trading agreement under the Paris Agreement. The deal is expected to open opportunities for climate finance, green investment and emissions-reduction projects.
nd50105f766.why: Carbon trading agreements under Article 6 of the Paris Agreement create frameworks for cross-border sales of emissions reductions, which investors track in climate finance.

n0e957bbe5c.headline: Kenya: You & Me Targets Sh200bn in Push to Finance Home Ownership
n0e957bbe5c.summary: You & Me Housing Co-operative Society is targeting a Sh200 billion asset base within 10 years. The funds are expected to finance members buying homes and investing in income-generating property.
n0e957bbe5c.why: Housing co-operatives pool member savings to finance home ownership, linking retail savings to property and mortgage markets.

n3e8910f96b.headline: Tajikistan updates NDC 3.0 to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 15% before 2035
n3e8910f96b.summary: Tajikistan has updated its NDC 3.0 to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 15% before 2035. The country estimates it needs $20 billion to $22.5 billion in funding to meet the target.
n3e8910f96b.why: Nationally determined contributions set the climate commitments that drive public and private green investment in developing economies.

n55bc170565.headline: Ex-defense minister Fedorov eyes Polish investor tie-up - media
n55bc170565.summary: Mykhailo Fedorov may announce cooperation in Warsaw on Tuesday with JRH ASI, a Polish investment company listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange, according to Rzeczpospolita. The report is unconfirmed.
n55bc170565.why: The Warsaw Stock Exchange is Central Europe's main equity venue, and listed investment companies like JRH ASI are tracked for capital flows into the region.

nd986803fc8.headline: Treasury Says Sh469 Billion Reached Counties in 2025/26, but Sh16.77 Billion in Extra Funds Fell Short
nd986803fc8.summary: Kenya's counties received Sh469 billion in the 2025/26 financial year, Treasury figures show. Sh16.77 billion in approved additional allocations was not disbursed, partly due to late enactment of the enabling law.
nd986803fc8.why: Counties depend on national transfers from the Treasury, so disbursement delays affect local public spending and the wider Kenyan fiscal picture.

ne5d5a17e59.summary: The official US dollar rate stood at 444.40 tenge on November 17. Exchange offices in the megacities offered the dollar in a range of 441 to 448 tenge.
ne5d5a17e59.why: The tenge's exchange rate against the dollar affects import costs, inflation and the valuation of dollar-denominated debt in Kazakhstan.

nfc920cd436.headline: Ukraine strike collapses section of Putin’s prized bridge to occupied Crimea
nfc920cd436.summary: A section of the multi-billion dollar bridge connecting Russia and the occupied Crimean Peninsula collapsed after a Ukrainian strike, according to CNN. The bridge is a strategic transport link.
nfc920cd436.why: The Crimean road and rail bridge is a key logistics route for Russian supply lines and trade into occupied Crimea.

nb3f6e905a6.headline: Signature Global Enters Maharashtra Property Market, Wins Auction For 474.66 Acres Of Land In Raigad For ₹194.19 Crore
nb3f6e905a6.summary: A Signature Global-led consortium won an auction bid for 474.66 acres of land in Maharashtra for ₹194.19 crore. The bid marks the company's entry into the Maharashtra property market.

n986441bb40.why: The Kirkuk-Ceyhan pipeline gives Iraq an export route that bypasses the Strait of Hormuz, adding supply to global crude markets.

nf6b7bfd7f6.headline: Trump begins Asia trip with Quad meet as China tripartite beckons
